attchmntText: Unaudited Financial Result for Quarter ended 30/09/2026
voiceSummary: Blue Chip India Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026. The company reported a net loss of 10.26 lacs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a loss of 16.04 lacs in the same period last year. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the net loss was 32.60 lacs, compared to 26.48 lacs in the previous year. Revenue from operations was 1750 lacs for the half year. The statutory auditors, Agarwal Sanganeria & Co., issued a limited review report with an exception regarding the valuation of inventories of unquoted shares. The company has filed a petition before the National Company Law Tribunal for reduction of paid-up share capital, which is pending final sanction.
